source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of consequences and severity (PDF 180-181).

blocks.text: Spam zyada tar pareshani hai, magar spyware zaati data chura kar privacy ke sangeen masail paida kar sakta, cookies sargarmi ka peecha kar ke privacy mein dakhal de sakti, aur phishing aur pharming maali nuqsan aur mujrimon ko accounts tak rasai de sakti hain. Kitab ke mutabiq 90% se zyada phishing hamle email se aate hain, is liye links dabane ya tafseel dene se pehle hamesha maakhaz jaanchein (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Spam, cookies aur phishing ko kam se zyada sangeen tak tarteeb dein, wajah ke saath.
blocks.explanation: Spam (zyada tar pareshani), cookies (privacy ka peecha), phishing (paisa aur accounts chura sakti hai).

items: Sangeeni pareshani (spam) se privacy ke nuqsan (spyware, cookies) aur paise aur account ke nuqsan (phishing, pharming) tak.
